2D.3 You shall not engage in idolatry and worship or serve the gods, idols or graven images of other nations.
2D.6 are commanded to destroy all pagan idols, shrines, alters, groves, pillars, images, etc., that are in the land.
2D.11 We are not to acknowledge the gods of heathen people by making mention of their name or by swearing by them.
2G.2 We are commanded not to worship, serve or sacrifice to the gods of the heathen.
2G.6 Do not covenant with the heathen or their gods, or keep company with the heathen and idolaters.
4C.4 You shall not take a bribe, for a bribe blinds the wise and subverts the cause of the just.
4E.1 You shall not bear false witness against another nor raise a false report.
4E.4 Do not join your hand with a wicked man to be an unrighteous witness.
4E.9 You shall not testify in a dispute for the sake of following the majority and thus pervert justice.
4F.3 You are not to be partial towards anyone or a respecter of persons in exacting justice, whether they be poor or rich, small or great.
4F.6 You shall keep far from a false matter.
4F.12 You shall not pervert judgment of the poor or needy in his cause but judge them righteously and deliver them out of the hand of the wicked.
7A.1 You are not to work animals on the Sabbath.
7C.3 If you encounter an animal of your enemy going astray, you shall bring it back to him.
7C.5 If you see an animal of one that hates you lying helpless under its load, you shall release the animal.
8C.4 Judges are not to be partial or respect persons in judgment, but shall equally judge the small as well as the great.
9A.5 The Feast of Unleavened Bread is to be celebrated the day after Passover (to eat unleavened bread seven days)
9A.8 The Feast of Harvest (the first-fruits of thy labor).
9A.9 The Feast of Ingathering.
9B.3 Three times in a year all males shall appear before the God of Israel, and make an offering to provide for the feasts.
9D.1 Six years you shall sow the land and reap its produce, but the seventh year you shall let the land lie fallow.
9D.4 The food which grows of itself can be taken by the poor to eat during the land Sabbath.
11C.1 Alliances and covenants (treaties) with pagan or ungodly nations are forbidden.

11D.5 You shall not allow foreigners that are pagans to emigrate into or dwell in your nation; for they shall be as pricks in your eyes and as thorns in your sides, and they shall trouble you in your land.
12E.2 You shall not go about speaking slander or spreading false reports about others.
14D.7 You are not to boil a kid in the milk of its mother.
14G.12 Health and healing come from obedience to the word and law of God.
19B.11 Do not show partiality in judgment.
19E.3 Slay not the innocent or the righteous.
19E.10 No punishment allowed by lynch mobs.
20E.3 We are to honor God by bringing the choice first fruits of our land into the house of God, so He may bring prosperity to us.
22F.10 If a people listen to God and walk in His ways and turn to God with prayer and repentance, He will release them from captivity and subdue their enemies.
